env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# Vendored ownership must not make wildcard-excluded fixtures active.
logos list example.com/dep/g
stdout '^example.com/dep/g$'
go list example.com/dep/g
stdout '^example.com/dep/g$'
